title: Usage Insights beta feedback tracker (Route/Model cost drivers + exports)
content:
Sheet purpose
- Track beta customer feedback for Usage Insights (cost drivers by route/model) and Export Reports (CSV/JSON) by account.
- Used for: weekly beta sync (Product/Eng/Design/Support), GA gating checklist, and comms prioritization.

Last updated: 2026-02-23 (owner: Markus Klein)

Quick rollup (as of last update)
- Accounts actively testing: 7
- P0/P1 items open: 6
- Most common themes:
  1) Invoice reconciliation confusion (timing, cached tokens, late metering)
  2) Export limits (time range, max rows) + desire for scheduled exports
  3) Route naming guidance + Unknown route dominating for SDKs not yet tagged
  4) Filters requested: environment, region, deployment mode, project

Legend
- Severity: P0 = blocks beta/GA for that account; P1 = major friction; P2 = meaningful improvement; P3 = nice-to-have.
- Status: New, Triaged, In Progress, Fix Shipped, Won’t Do (GA), Needs Customer, Closed.

Table (feedback items)
Columns:
Account | HubSpot/Source | Deployment | Beta start | Feedback summary | Area | Severity | Requested filter/export details | Proposed approach / notes | Status | Owner | Target / next step | Last touch

1) Northbridge Health (regulated) | hubspot:company-1207789; fireflies:meeting-d4e7ff02 | Private (VPC) POC | 2026-02-05 | Export audit evidence: security team wants “who/what/filters” fields and retention policy spelled out; asked for proof screenshot/log sample | Security/Compliance | P0 | Export audit logs + RBAC boundaries + retention | Align with audit event spec (export.created/export.downloaded). Need customer-facing explanation + sample JSON event payload. Ensure export includes org_id/project_id + filters + row_count + file_hash. | In Progress | Kevin Osei / Naomi Feldman | Provide security one-pager + console screenshots by 2026-02-28 | 2026-02-21

2) FinOpsly (mid-market SaaS) | hubspot:company-1198827; fireflies:meeting-9b1d0e44 | Hosted API | 2026-02-03 | Export job timeout for large ranges; wants “previous 30 days” exports without trial-and-error | Export performance | P0 | Export job: larger time ranges; guidance on paging; want clearer limits upfront | Confirm hard limits in UI + API error messaging: max_days, max_rows, recommended hourly granularity. Consider “Estimate rows” preflight. | Triaged | Nadia Rahman / Allison Grant | Validate final limits vs benchmarks; update docs FAQ + UI copy | 2026-02-19

3) AtlasPay | support:SUP-18420 | Dedicated | 2026-02-07 | Route costs don’t match invoice totals; finance escalated | Reconciliation | P0 | “Explain mismatch” + export fields to match invoice dimensions | Add in-console banner/tooltips: metering latency + cached token accounting. Provide “Reconciliation checklist” doc. Support needs canned response and example math. | In Progress | Dev Patel / Paula Mendes | Close SUP-18420 with explanation + link to docs; add console FAQ link | 2026-02-20

4) Loomly AI | hubspot:company-1203301; fireflies:meeting-3c88aa10 | Hosted API | 2026-02-06 | Wants weekly scheduled exports + webhook/S3 destination (chargeback automation) | Exports | P1 | Scheduled exports (weekly) + destination delivery | Non-goal for GA; offer interim: API export job + script + service account. Track as roadmap request; ensure export schema stability. | Triaged | Paula Mendes | Follow-up with workaround guide + sample script by 2026-03-04 | 2026-02-18

5) Northbridge Health (regulated) | hubspot:company-1207789 | Private (VPC) POC | 2026-02-05 | RBAC concern: ensure exports cannot cross project boundary; asked about auditability when admin downloads on behalf | RBAC | P0 | Project scoping + admin behavior | Confirm enforcement: org_id + project_id mandatory for export; deny if no project scope unless org-level role. Document roles required. Add tests (ENG-8428). | In Progress | Kaitlyn Nguyen / Marcus Lin | Provide written answer for their security questionnaire; add to docs | 2026-02-21

6) BrightNote | beta email thread (via CS) | Hosted API | 2026-02-10 | “Unknown route” dominates top drivers; they use streaming + older Python SDK | Route tagging | P1 | Better defaults; route tagging guidance; identify missing tags | Likely missing header/SDK param. Need SDK upgrade guidance and gateway-derived fallback route where possible. Also add console callout: “X% traffic missing route tag”. | In Progress | Monica Patel / Wei Chen | Reach out with upgrade steps + snippet; confirm in 48h | 2026-02-22

7) AcmeDocs | internal dogfood (Redwood) | Hosted API | 2026-02-01 | Wants filter for environment (prod/staging) and ability to save filter sets | Filters/UX | P2 | environment filter + saved views | Environment dimension already in pipeline for many orgs; confirm availability for insights aggregations. Saved views likely post-GA. | Triaged | Dylan Brooks / Felix Schneider | Confirm feasibility for Phase 2; update GA scope doc | 2026-02-16

8) Octarine Search | hubspot:company-1201044 (prospect in Dedicated eval) | Dedicated trial | 2026-02-08 | Needs model breakdown to include “fallback model” vs “requested model” when smart routing changes mid-request | Attribution | P1 | Export field: requested_model vs served_model; UI: show fallback events | Ensure event schema captures both. Console should attribute spend to route; model breakdown by served_model with note. Consider separate breakdown toggle. | Triaged | Caleb Johnson / Jada Williams | Revisit after ENG-8435 test plan; propose schema additions | 2026-02-17

9) FinOpsly (mid-market SaaS) | hubspot:company-1198827 | Hosted API | 2026-02-03 | Wants region filter (us-east / eu-west) and export column for region | Filters/Export schema | P2 | region dimension + export columns | Region already part of request context; confirm aggregation availability + cardinality budget. Likely OK for filters; export should include region when requested. | Triaged | Mei Lin | Confirm dataset column presence; update API contract if needed | 2026-02-19

10) AtlasPay | support:SUP-18458 | Dedicated | 2026-02-07 | Export job fails with timeout; needs clearer error code and retry guidance | Export reliability | P1 | Better retry semantics; job status clarity | Add explicit error codes (EXPORT_TOO_LARGE, EXPORT_TIMEOUT) and recommended max ranges. Improve UI: show “shrink date range” guidance. | In Progress | Chloe Martin / Allison Grant | Ship fix + update docs troubleshooting | 2026-02-20

11) BrightNote | beta email thread | Hosted API | 2026-02-10 | Wants route naming conventions for frameworks (FastAPI, Express) and guidance on dynamic route params | Docs/DevEx | P2 | Examples + warnings for cardinality | Add concrete examples: “POST /v1/summarize” not “/v1/summarize/{userId}”. Provide 5–7 recommended patterns + lint suggestions. | Triaged | Elliot Price / Wei Chen | Add to docs page + quickstart PR | 2026-02-22

12) Octarine Search | hubspot:company-1201044 | Dedicated trial | 2026-02-08 | Requests pagination in top routes view beyond 100 and ability to download “top 1,000 routes” | UI/Query limits | P2 | larger page sizes + export of ranked list | Keep UI page size limited; use export for large sets. Ensure export supports sorted-by-spend route list. Add guidance on query cost. | Triaged | Felix Schneider / Logan Wright | Confirm API pagination limits & UI behavior; update roadmap notes | 2026-02-17

13) Loomly AI | hubspot:company-1203301 | Hosted API | 2026-02-06 | Export schema stability: worried about breaking finance automation if CSV columns change | Export schema/versioning | P1 | Versioned export schema; changelog | Provide “schema_version” field in JSON export + CSV header stability promise. If changes, add new columns only; never rename without version bump. Document policy. | In Progress | Nadia Rahman | Align with schema versioning thread; add docs section | 2026-02-18

14) AcmeDocs | internal dogfood | Hosted API | 2026-02-01 | UI request: “What changed” should compare vs prior period with explicit dates and percent + absolute deltas (spend + tokens) | UX | P3 | clearer delta presentation | Likely already planned; ensure copy includes exact ranges. | Triaged | Tessa Morgan | Add to design polish backlog | 2026-02-16

15) AtlasPay | support:SUP-18441 | Dedicated | 2026-02-07 | Unknown route is large due to gateway traffic not using SDK headers; wants gateway-derived route from HTTP path | Route derivation | P1 | gateway-derived route + normalization rules | Implement gateway derivation when header missing; normalize (strip IDs) and cap cardinality; follow ADR route rules. | In Progress | Amara Diallo / Thomas Baird | Validate derivation rules with customer paths; test in staging | 2026-02-20

Notes / GA gating candidates (working)
- Must close P0s (security audit/RBAC, export timeouts + clear limits, invoice mismatch comms) OR have acceptable mitigations with sign-off.
- If “Unknown route” > 10–15% of traffic for common SDK versions, add prominent console callout + docs + SDK upgrade path before GA.
- Export schema policy must be documented (minimum: add-only columns + schema_version for JSON).

Next beta sync agenda (draft)
- Review P0 list and owners (Kevin/Kaitlyn/Nadia/Dev)
- Decide: region filter (P2) in GA vs post-GA
- Confirm export size limits + console UI copy
- Confirm customer comms artifacts: reconciliation FAQ + security one-pager
